dialogues.speaker: Saimon Jirou
dialogues.text: Ahh... I—It's you... I'm really sorry about the treasure, and for having caused you so much trouble. Anyway, I'm very thankful for your help!

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Jirou
dialogues.text: Will you continue to travel? To be honest, I never want to leave my house again after what happened...
